elymas_403.name: Elymas
elymas_403.title: Elymas
elymas_403.dict: magician or sorcerer, the Arabic name of the Jew Bar-jesus, who withstood Paul and Barnabas in Cyprus. He was miraculously struck with blindness (Acts 13:11).

eutychus_1230.name: Eutychus
eutychus_1230.title: Eutychus
eutychus_1230.dict: fortunate, (Acts 20:9-12), a young man of Troas who fell through drowsiness from the open window of the third floor of the house where Paul was preaching, and was "taken up dead." The lattice-work of the window being open to admit the air, the lad fell out and down to the court below. Paul restored him to life again. (Compare 1 Kings 17:21 ; 2 Kings 4:34 .)
